 Mostly dry, few sprinkles possible today and tomorrow 
 A big cool-down is in the extended forecast 
 Costumes and tailgate plans are safe! Expect mild 60s and mostly dry conditions for Halloween and the Bengals game. By Erin Ashley Published : Oct. 31, 2026 at 5:50 AM EDT | Updated : Oct. 31, 2026 at 10:11 AM EDT Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google CINCINNATI (WXIX) — A mild but slightly unsettled weekend is ahead across the Tri-State, with clouds and isolated shower chances in the forecast before a strong midweek cold front brings a big temperature drop.
 A few passing upper-level disturbances will keep skies mainly cloudy through Sunday. While widespread rain is not expected, a stray shower or sprinkle is possible starting Saturday afternoon.
 Trick-or-Treat: Mainly dry and cloudy for most neighborhoods, with only an isolated sprinkle. It will be noticeably mild for late October, with temperatures hovering in the mid-to-upper 60s throughout the evening. 
 Sunday & Bengals Game: A few scattered showers could linger into early Sunday morning, but conditions should trend mainly dry in time for the Bengals game. Expect lingering cloud cover with highs reaching the mid-to-upper 60s. 
 Sunshine makes a return on Monday, pushing afternoon temperatures back into the lower 70s through early next week.
 Rain and thunderstorm chances ramp up midday Wednesday ahead of a potent cold front. Expect widespread rain and gusty winds to continue through Thursday, ushering in a much cooler airmass by Friday. Highs next weekend will struggle to reach the mid-50s.
